title: Can Increased Body Mass Index Prevent Adequate Ultrasound Examination for Trisomy 21 Risk Assessment?
brief_summary: Determine Cutoff BMI at which transabdominal sonography (TAS) is not satisfactory for aneuploidy risk assessment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* women who have a live, intrauterine, singleton pregnancy between 11- 14 weeks gestation.

Exclusion Criteria:

* multiple gestation.
* fetal size outside of nuchal translucency screening age (crown-rump length (CRL) outside of 46-71 mm).
* presence of a cystic hygroma.
* fetal demise.
study_population: Inclusion criteria will consist of women who have a live, intrauterine, singleton pregnancy between 11- 14 weeks gestation.
